brief:
Jerusalem Electricity Company announced a temporary suspension of meter charging and bill payment operations across all its branches, offices, and authorized charging centers, the Maan Wire reported. The stoppage also affects self-service machines, the company's mobile application, and the E-SADAD platform on banking and digital wallet applications.

The company did not specify the duration or reason for the suspension in its announcement.

title: Jerusalem Electricity Company halts meter charging and bill payments
